history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop stand-alone performance evaluation standards and prepare performance reports for health insurance service providers that reflect the Organization’s own requests and needs in order to benefit future decision- making processes.
history.administration_response: Key performance indicators are in place for all health insurance service providers. The incorporation of standardized key performance indicators into the contracts with third-party administrators is evident in the recent contract for the Medical Insurance Plan, which took effect in April 2024. It is therefore requested that this recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that standardized key performance indicators have been incorporated into the contracts with third- party administrators, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
